tiers.description: Patients pay only a minimum fee by tier: Category A $25, B $30, C $35, D $40; otherwise full fee. FPL ranges for each category are not stated.

evidence.quote: In order to qualify for the program, patients must provide proof of income below 200% of the current federal poverty level.

how_to_apply: Complete the FA application with proof of income; submit at any Heartland Health Services clinic or mail to Heartland Health Services, Attn: Financial Assistance, 2214 N University, Peoria, IL 61604; questions: Michelle at (309) 680-7639.
warnings: This is an FQHC sliding fee schedule for primary care visits, not a hospital charity care policy.
No free-care threshold is stated; minimum fees of $25-$40 apply even in discounted tiers.
FPL boundaries for Categories A-D are not given in the text.
Insured patients may apply for the discount to apply to co-insurance or deductible portions; insurance is billed first.
Discount is honored for one year from application date, then must reapply.
